results.source: docs/proposals/11-further-improvements/sections/01-evidence.tex probe 10; exact finite contract copied from tests/benchmarks/extended.json probe10_drop_zeros; Lean v4.34.0 Init/Data/List/Basic.lean List.filter and Init/Data/List/Lemmas.lean List.filter_cons
results.transcript:

:{
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  if (Leant2.resultBinding? (← getEnv) `it1).isSome then
    elabCommand (← `(example : List Nat → List Nat := it1))
    elabCommand (← `(example : ∀ xs : List Nat, it1 xs = List.filter (fun n => n != 0) xs := by intro xs; induction xs with | nil => rfl | cons n xs ih => cases hd : (inferInstance : Decidable (n = 0)) with | isFalse h => have hb : (n != 0) = true := bne_iff_ne.mpr h; simpa only [it1, List.filter, hd, hb] using congrArg (List.cons n) ih | isTrue h => simp_all [it1, List.filter]))
    elabCommand (← `(#eval if decide (it1 [] = [] ∧ it1 [0] = [] ∧ it1 [6] = [6] ∧ it1 [0, 7, 0, 7, 8, 0] = [7, 7, 8] ∧ it1 [9, 0, 0, 1, 0, 2, 0] = [9, 1, 2] ∧ it1 (List.replicate 24 0 ++ [3, 0, 3, 0, 4]) = [3, 3, 4]) then "EXTENDED_REPLAY_OK" else "EXTENDED_REPLAY_FALSE"))
:}
:quit
